title: OWNER (~2 min, CrowdWorks only): log back in to crowdworks.jp in the dedicated crowdworks-profile
detail: Found 22:30 JST 10/10 during h1-crowdworks-scan-1010: the header in the dedicated crowdworks-profile (server playwright-crowdworks) shows ログイン/会員登録, with no logout link. The public screen still works, but no proposal can be sent from a logged-out profile. Profile path: /Users/kinoshitatsukasa/Library/Application Support/AIRevenueExperiment/browser-profiles/crowdworks-profile (same as crowdworks-profile-init on 10/07, Google OAuth). Pairs with owner-crowdworks-proposal-permission (both are needed before sends).
acceptance: crowdworks.jp header shows マイページ (not ログイン/会員登録) in the crowdworks-profile
